name: Parade Weekend
tagline: 3 fly down Wed night or Thu, 1 flies Fri morning for the 10:05 AM parade, all 4 home Monday
vibe: Built around one fixed event — Thandi's MBG parade at Epcot Friday morning. Everything else is park time.
highlights: MBG parade at Epcot — Fri Nov 6, 10:05 AM

days.label: Day 1 — Wednesday, Nov 4
days.theme: Band bus leaves · 3 travelers may fly down tonight

legs.notes: Only if taking a Wednesday-evening flight. Wed nonstops to MCO are $450+/person; the value is PHL→TPA nonstop (Frontier 8:20 PM) or a 1-stop to MCO.
Option: Frontier PHL→TPA 8:20 PM → 11:08 PM, then 1h20 drive to Disney (arrive ~1 AM). See 'Flights down — 3 travelers'.

segments.activity: Thandi drops luggage at CHS band room for admin check; MBG buses depart (time TBD)
OPTIONAL — 3 travelers fly down tonight (PHL→TPA nonstop or PHL→MCO 1-stop). Skip if flying Thursday.

days.notes: If the 3 fly Thursday instead, there is no Wednesday hotel night — adjust the hotel reservation to Nov 5–9.

days.label: Day 2 — Thursday, Nov 5
days.theme: Band arrives · 3 travelers fly down (if not Wed)

legs.notes: Thursday Trenton option: Frontier 8:01 PM → MCO 10:48 PM.
Or PHL Frontier via Detroit (12:10 PM → 8:35 PM, cheapest) / PHL→TPA Frontier 5:59 PM nonstop. See flight options.
Pick up rental car at MCO (or TPA if flying there).

segments.activity: MBG arrives at hotel, students dropped at a park (Park Hopper passes, staff check-ins)
3 travelers land (Trenton 10:48 PM / PHL-Detroit 8:35 PM / Tampa 8:46 PM), rental car, check in

days.label: Day 3 — Friday, Nov 6

legs.notes: 4th traveler: Frontier PHL 5:15 AM → MCO 8:01 AM is the only flight that makes the parade. Leave home ~2:45 AM.
Rideshare straight to Epcot (~$40–50) or get picked up by the others. Tight but doable for 10:05.

segments.activity: 4th traveler lands (Frontier from PHL) — straight to Epcot
MBG arrives at Epcot in full uniform — warm-up and final prep
Family enters Epcot — stake out a spot on the World Showcase route (UK pavilion → American Adventure)
MBG PARADE step-off (UK pavilion), concludes at the American Adventure
Students change, drop uniforms on the bus, rejoin the park. Family: Epcot for the day

days.notes: If based in Tampa: leave by 7:15 AM for the 10:05 parade (I-4 east is slow Friday mornings; ~1h45). If at Pop Century / Art of Animation / Caribbean Beach: take the Skyliner to Epcot's International Gateway — it opens onto the UK pavilion where the parade steps off.

days.label: Day 4 — Saturday, Nov 7
days.theme: Band workshop (students only) · family park day

segments.activity: HVBands soundtrack workshop with professional musicians — friends and family NOT permitted
Family park day — Magic Kingdom or Hollywood Studios (one park per day on a base ticket)

days.notes: Tampa base = ~3 hrs round-trip driving + $30 parking per park day. Near-parks lodging options are in the Reservations tab.

days.label: Day 5 — Sunday, Nov 8
days.theme: Last band park day · buses leave tonight

segments.activity: MBG loads buses with luggage/equipment and departs for NJ (return to CHS Monday, time TBD)

days.notes: Tampa base = ~3 hrs round-trip driving + $30 parking per park day. Near-parks lodging options are in the Reservations tab.

legs.notes: Return rental at MCO — or drive 1h20 to TPA if the cheaper Tampa return wins.
See 'Flights home — all 4'. Thandi comes home on the band bus.

segments.activity: Optional half park day if on an evening flight; otherwise check out
